_comment: Guard states that aibuild-lab/aibl-installer itself deployed to students before the current release. Each record is one exact version of hooks/secrets-guard.manifest.json on main: `files` are the canonical bytes its refresher installed at that commit, and `local_files` are the reviewed adapters and supplements it copied from the same commit; that refresher refused any file whose hash differed. Reviewed bytes establish identity only: a receipt-free installation is attributed only when every version-distinct file of each client belongs to the same `ref`, and it still needs a separate human approval. refresh-guard.mjs pins this file's LF-normalized sha256 (INSTALLER_DEPLOYED_IDENTITIES_SHA256); change both in one reviewed pull request, and add a record only with its source commit proven.
